identity.//: As totk.json. The Wii U and Cemu entry is DELIBERATELY UNSET: the host cannot find its own read-only data on those platforms, so the address has to be declared - and it must point into the RPX's .rodata, which nobody has looked up yet. It previously pointed at 0x02000030, which is in .text and is the exact address examples/patch_mod patches. An unset slice makes the host say it cannot fingerprint, which is true; a wrong one would have it report a number that changes with the mods installed.
